Conditions that apply: Neighbouring or street trees affected; Lawful offsite tree access confirmed; Works affect trees roots or canopy; Tree pruning removal or clearance proposed; Work to an existing building; Site stays occupied or operating during the works; Delivered in stages.
Conditions that do not apply: Heritage item or conservation area.

### 2. Scope of services

You are the arborist. Your job is to tell the client which trees matter, how the works will affect them, and how to protect the ones being kept, so design and approval decisions rest on sound tree evidence.
To do this you:
- Assess the scheduled trees: their health, value and root zones.
- Advise the design team on encroachments, and on how to protect or remove trees.
- Report in the form the consent authority needs.
Advise within your competence. The client or planning lead obtains permissions; a competent tree-work contractor carries out pruning, removal and protection. Your advice grants no permission and does not guarantee survival or future safety; tell us at once about any urgent concern.
Coordinate with the surveyor, landscape architect, civil and structural engineers and utility designers; they keep their design responsibility. Issue revision-controlled PDF and CAD plans, calculations and editable registers that say whether each fact was observed, measured, reported or inferred, any access limits, who receives the advice and who may rely on it.
Tree basis: Confirm survey/DWG revision, IDs/count/ownership, inaccessible trees, works/access/laydown footprints, services, current controls/editions and permission owner.

Written instruction/agreed inputs to named output/response end. Price once across stages and positions; options need written activation. ### 5. Terms

- Attached Project arborist agreement (attached), agreed fees/scope, numbered addenda and written acceptance govern; settle precedence. RFP does not authorise work; no automatic supplier terms, guarantees or asset security.
- Before extra scope/ceiling overrun or rate/fee/program change, obtain representative written authority with reason, scope, basis and time effect; agree delay/aborted-visit/remobilisation consequences.
- Signed brief/revisions set baseline; agreed coordination, rounds, routine administration and normal development included. Distinguish clarification from changed design/evidence.
- Correct own errors without extra fee; reasonable professional skill/care within competence. Evidence limits do not negate agreed duties.
- Hold professional indemnity cover of Client-selected $5m and public liability cover of Client-selected $20m throughout the appointment.
- Payment 30 days after correct invoice for agreed services; state milestones/GST. Declare deposits, report-release restrictions, interest, recovery, security and suspension departures.
- State rates/fixed period and all third-party/travel/access costs; agree changes before work. Historical prices are not the budget.
- Agree project/team/authority/operator use, third-party reliance, native files/retention/handover and confidentiality; marketing needs consent. Resolve IP, caps/indemnities, law/disputes, assignment/novation and notice/cure/suspension/termination in agreement.
- Proposal valid 90 days from closing. Set project insurance and agreement choices before appointment.
- Issue numbered addenda to all tenderers, acknowledged in proposal.
